covenants.name: Weihan Cynn
covenants.summary: Pagan witches who have ruled Kindred Britain for centuries by striking bargains with its werewolves, spirits and other monsters, and playing them against each other.

merits.name: Envoy
merits.summary: A respected envoy of the Post. Anyone pursuing or intercepting you between cities needs more successes than your dots. You arrive with a gift worth a one-time Social bonus with whoever you're travelling to, and once a story half your dots count as Allies or Contacts in a new city.

merits.name: Contract With the Uncanny
merits.summary: Call on your covenant's ancient pacts with one supernatural faction or force for favors. Each must be repaid in kind, and favors above your dots cost more in return; renege and you lose the Merit and suffer their backlash.
